description: Game context for an event — the conditions a prop settles under. MLB: probable starting pitchers and their throwing hand (L/R/S — platoon-split context for every batter prop), a confirmed-lineup flag, the home-plate umpire, and first-pitch weather (temperature, wind, precipitation) at outdoor / open-roof venues (indoor venues return weather=null). NFL & NCAAF: the venue and kickoff weather. The same block is embedded in get_event_results, so every graded prop carries its conditions — unique to PropLine. Free tier. 404 when no context is on file for the event yet.
name: propline_get_event_context
title: Get event context
